policy: Provider registry is discovery configuration, not blanket authorization to retrieve, retain, or redistribute artifacts.

providers.name: NASA Technical Reports Server API
providers.artifact_policy: Record NASA distribution, copyright and export-control metadata before artifact retention.

providers.name: NASA Open APIs
providers.artifact_policy: Use service-specific terms and rate limits; API catalog coverage is not exhaustive.

providers.name: OpenAlex
providers.artifact_policy: Metadata graph provider; resolve full text separately and honor work-level rights.

providers.name: Crossref REST API
providers.artifact_policy: Metadata is generally reusable; abstracts and linked full text may carry separate copyright.

providers.name: arXiv public API
providers.artifact_policy: Treat metadata/API terms separately from e-print copyright; redistribution of e-prints requires rights-holder permission. Apply API rate limits.

providers.name: European Patent Office Open Patent Services
providers.artifact_policy: Respect OPS terms, quotas and field-level rights; store credential state separately from source records.

providers.name: WIPO PATENTSCOPE
providers.artifact_policy: WIPO terms prohibit automated queries, scraping and bulk acquisition/download/storage. Use manual discovery/permalinks or separately licensed WIPO data products only.

providers.name: GitHub REST API
providers.artifact_policy: Clone/archive source only when repository license and terms permit; preserve owner, repo ID, commit SHA, license and retrieval time.

providers.name: SpaceX public publications site API
providers.artifact_policy: Read-only discovery seed; verify source URLs, copyright, publisher context and any site terms before downloading or retaining files.

providers.name: r/SpaceX community API
providers.artifact_policy: Explicitly unaffiliated with SpaceX; supplemental reference only, retain third-party provenance and independently corroborate material claims.

providers.name: Tesla public engineering and investor-relations surfaces
providers.artifact_policy: Use official Tesla and SEC-hosted documents as evidence leads. Record filing/report revision and publication date; distinguish company statements from independent validation; review copyright and document terms before retaining full artifacts.

deferred_sources.name: USPTO Open Data Portal
deferred_sources.reason: Confirm current official API contract, key requirements, retention terms and bulk data interfaces before enabling ingestion.
